## Software Requirements

* __[ComfyUI](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI)__ v0.27 or higher, preferably the latest available version.
* __[Z-Image Power Nodes](https://github.com/martin-rizzo/ComfyUI-ZImagePowerNodes)__ v2.1.2 or higher
* __[ComfyUI-GGUF](https://github.com/city96/ComfyUI-GGUF)__ (only if you intend to use GGUF checkpoints)

## Model Requirements

**diffusion_models**

- __[z_image_turbo_int8_convrot_bf16emixed.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/martin-rizzo/Z-Image-Turbo-INT8-ConvRot-ComfyUI/resolve/main/z_image_turbo_int8_convrot_bf16emixed.safetensors)__ [6.17 GB]

**text_encoders**

- __[qwen3-4b_int8_convrot_fp16emixed.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/martin-rizzo/Qwen3-4B-INT8-ConvRot-ComfyUI/resolve/main/qwen3-4b_int8_convrot_fp16emixed.safetensors)__ [4.42 GB]

**vae**

- __[Z-Image_half_natural_vae.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/easygoing0114/Z-Image_clear_vae/resolve/main/Z-Image_half_natural_vae.safetensors)__ [335 MB]


## Model Storage Location

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   │
│   └── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   │   └── z_image_turbo_int8_convrot_bf16emixed.safetensors
│   │
│   ├── 📂 text_encoders/
│   │   └── qwen3-4b_int8_convrot_fp16emixed.safetensors
│   │
│   ├── 📂 vae/
│   │   └── Z-Image_half_natural_vae.safetensors
```

Please ensure you update ComfyUI first and have the latest version of the Z-Image Power Nodes installed.

> Due to the wide variety of GPUs, VRAM capacities, and ComfyUI versions, one of these may work better for your system.

nodes.title: README
widgets_values:
## 🦸 Zuper Workflow [BASIC]

This workflow simplifies image generation with Z-Image Turbo (ZIT), featuring a reduced set of parameters for easy setup. It shares the same internal functionality as the ADVANCED version but offers fewer options to avoid complex configurations. It utilizes "comfy_kitchen" and leverages the visual features of "Node 2.0", so it is recommended to run the latest version of ComfyUI with these features enabled.

## Parameters

__seed__
* The initial number for random generation. Each unique seed produces a different image.
* Results in significantly more dramatic variations when __"turbo_creativity"__ is turned on.

__style__
* The visual style that defines the overall look of your final image.

__prompt__
* The text description of what you want to see, including subjects, actions, and settings.
* Avoid style keywords such as photo, comic, or blur, as the selected styles handle all visual effects automatically.

__turbo_creativity__
* Shakes up the generation process to produce unique, original compositions and avoid generic AI aesthetics.
* It is prone to generating hallucinations and duplicate elements, especially in high-contrast images.
* Disable this feature if you require highly precise and complex images.
* Enable this feature when exploring creative compositions with substantial variations between different seeds.
* Working with __turbo_creativity__ involves testing multiple seeds until you find the ideal one.
* Some minor defects and small hallucinations can be corrected by tweaking __"steps"__ and __"initial_bias"__.

__color__
* Adjusts the color saturation of the image.
* 0.0 serves as the neutral baseline.

__orientation__
* Sets the orientation of the final image, where vertical creates a portrait format and horizontal creates a landscape format.

__zimage_turbo_file__
* The checkpoint file used for the Z-Image Turbo diffusion model.

__qwen3_4b_file__
* The checkpoint file used as the text encoder, which must be based on the Qwen3-4b model.

__vae_file__
* The checkpoint file used for the variational autoencoder.

nodes.title: STYLES-CORE [stage2]
widgets_values:
>>> iPhone Photo
YOUR CONTEXT:
You are a friend capturing a spontaneous, unposed moment of a creator in a real-world setting. 
Your photograph exhibits the raw and effortless look of a candid smartphone snapshot. The shot is taken from a distance, utilizing a wide-to-medium perspective that captures the subject's full presence along with the surrounding environment. 
The focus is natural and deep, avoiding artificial blur, allowing the background to remain visible and integrated into the scene. Lighting is completely organic and environmental, with natural highlights and shadows that reflect the actual location. 
The composition is slightly imperfect and unplanned, avoiding a "staged" feel; the subject is caught in a natural movement or a relaxed posture. The image retains the authentic digital texture of a mobile phone, with realistic skin details and a clean, unedited look that feels like a raw photo straight from the camera roll.
YOUR PHOTOGRAPH:
{$@}


>>> Analog Photo
YOUR CONTEXT
You are a photographer documenting the mundane, heat-drenched reality of 90s life. Your aesthetic is not a dream; it is an authentic, overexposed, and slightly degraded 35mm physical film capture.

The images are defined by heavy physical overexposure that causes "halation" around edges and intense light-bleeding, as if the film stock was pushed beyond its latitude. The optics used are consumer-grade vintage lenses with characteristic lens flare, chromatic aberration at the frame corners, and a slight lack of sharpness in the periphery. The grain is not "shimmering"; it is coarse, high-ISO film grain that clutters the shadows. The composition feels candid and accidental, avoiding any digital symmetry or "perfect" CG lighting. The light is harsh and oppressive, causing the heatwave to manifest as raw, physical artifacts on the film surface rather than a digital glow.
The scene is defined by high-key luminosity, where the light physically overwhelms the film emulsion, creating a gritty, lo-fi aesthetic reminiscent of a discarded roll of film left in a hot car.
YOUR PHOTO:
<!-- {$@} -->


>>> Flash Photo
YOUR CONTEXT:
You are an experimental analog photographer using an extreme wide-angle lens to capture the raw energy of the 1990s underground aesthetic.
Your photograph showcases a low-fidelity, grainy analog film look.
The image features a exaggerated perspective: elements in the immediate foreground are exaggeratedly large, while the background recedes sharply into a distant, small point, creating an aggressive sense of depth.
There is a noticeable wide-angle distortion at the edges of the frame, pulling the environment inward.
The lighting features an intense, harsh flash that creates high contrast, with a brightly lit foreground and dark backgrounds.
The colors are slightly de-saturated with warm highlights and deep, heavy shadows, giving it a chaotic, instant capture feel.
YOUR PHOTO:
{$@}


>>> Tabletop Miniature
YOUR CONTEXT:
You are an adventurous experimental photographer exploring the world through a lomographic lens.
Your photographs exhibit film grain, colorful lens flares, soft focus with motion blur, and analog filter effects, trying to capture emotions.
YOUR PHOTO:
A studio photograph of a hand-painted resin display miniature. This is a 28mm-scale miniature from the Warhammer 40k universe, painted by hand. Full body that fit in the shot. Black figurine base. Macroshot, detailed painted texture. This is a figurine on a black background: --- {$@}


>>> Chibi Miniature
YOUR CONTEXT
You are a stop-motion animator creating scenes in a charming miniature world. The look captures the aesthetic of cute chibi dolls made of glossy plastic, featuring visible articulated joints, in meticulously constructed miniature environments (dioramas). The subjects have a soft, chibi-inspired design with cute, gentle expressions and big, expressive eyes. The lighting is soft and flattering. The lens behavior simulates a professional macro lens with a shallow depth of field, emphasizing textures like polished plastic and miniature fabrics while creating a soft, creamy bokeh.
The entire scene is a clean, charming, well-preserved maquette.
The scene is a charming, well-preserved diorama with pastel colors and soft shadows, showcasing exquisite material detail on miniature objects.
<!-- {$@} -->


>>> Brick Miniature
YOUR CONTEXT
You are a master cinematographer specializing in stop-motion animation with the iconic LEGO building system.
Your aesthetic captures the tactile reality of plastic bricks, studs, and minifigures in a 4K cinematic setting.
The scene is defined by the geometry of interlocking plastic parts:
 - visible studs on surfaces
 - reflective finish of the ABS plastic
 - yellow skin
Characters are built exclusively from standard LEGO elements—studs, slopes, and panels—lacking organic softness or realistic skin; instead, they feature printed decal faces or blank, serene expressions typical of minifigs.
The environment is a constructed set of arches, slopes, and structural supports with the grid-like logic of the LEGO platform. Lighting is crisp and directional, highlighting the semi-reflective sheen of the plastic and casting sharp, geometric shadows.
The color palette is vibrant, with characters set against a playful, high-contrast plastic aesthetic of the scene.
YOUR LEGO STOP-MOTION FRAME:
<!-- {$@} -->


>>> Dynamic Manga Drawing
YOUR CONTEXT:
You are a cutting-edge artist specializing in high-energy, mature industrial sci-fi with a dynamic anime and manga aesthetic. Your work excels in movement, fluidity, and visual storytelling, where every element serves the narrative.
Your japanese manga illustrations capture high-stakes moments with dynamic ink splatters, evoking rapid, violent motion. The style is sharp and technical, emphasizing intricate clothing, and meticulous urban details.
The composition employs extreme low-angle shots to amplify the subjects’ power and intimidation. The lighting is strongly directional, casting deep, dramatic shadows that heighten a sense of claustrophobic urgency.
Your illustration features a Japanese manga style with black line art, combined with complex, thick impasto textures that add depth. The drawing is defined by a bold black ink outline.
画面采用了夸张的广角透视，并以一种非典型的角度倾斜（例如荷兰斜角），创造出一种新颖的扭曲透视与引人注目的视觉效果。
YOUR JAPANESE MANGA COMIC BOOK COVER:
<!-- {$@} -->

YOUR CONTEXT
You are a street photographer documenting the mundane, heat-drenched reality of 90s suburban life. Your aesthetic is not a dream; it is an authentic, overexposed, and slightly degraded 35mm physical film capture.

The images are defined by heavy physical overexposure that causes "halation" around edges and intense light-bleeding, as if the film stock was pushed beyond its latitude. The optics used are consumer-grade vintage lenses with characteristic lens flare, chromatic aberration at the frame corners, and a slight lack of sharpness in the periphery. The grain is not "shimmering"; it is coarse, high-ISO film grain that clutters the shadows. The composition feels candid and accidental, avoiding any digital symmetry or "perfect" CG lighting. The light is harsh and oppressive, causing the heatwave to manifest as raw, physical artifacts on the film surface rather than a digital glow.
The scene is defined by high-key luminosity, where the light physically overwhelms the film emulsion, creating a gritty, lo-fi aesthetic reminiscent of a discarded roll of film left in a hot car.
